Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Quantity Surveyor to join our team!

The Quantity Surveyor will provide cost management, contract administration, and commercial support across all packages of a mixed‑use development. Working in a PMC role, the QS safeguards the client’s financial interests by monitoring budgets, validating contractor payments, managing variations and claims, and ensuring accurate cost reporting throughout the project lifecycle.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or related discipline; professional QS membership (e.g., MRICS) is an advantage.
Typically 3-8 years of experience in quantity surveying and cost management on building projects, preferably mixed‑use or large real estate developments.
Experience within PMC organizations, consultants, or major contractors.

Strong understanding of: Standard methods of measurement and BOQ preparation, Contract forms (e.g., FIDIC, NEC, local standard forms), Construction techniques for buildings and infrastructure, and their cost drivers.

Proficiency in: MS Excel (advanced) for cost analysis and reporting, Cost management/QS software (e.g., Candy, CostX, or similar – desirable), MS Project/Primavera (basic understanding) for linking cost and time.
Excellent numerical and analytical skills with high attention to detail.
Ability to work under time pressure while maintaining accuracy and integrity.
Good understanding of both technical construction aspects and commercial implications.
Ethical, transparent, and client‑focused approach to cost management.
